mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -11.7% (t-3w) to -8.4% (t-0w), a 3.3 percentage-point improvement. This sustained upward trend in retail mobility signals recovery momentum that will continue over the next four weeks, producing higher mean RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 3.3 points over four weeks
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean over the last 28 days (-10.3%).

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility collapsed from -10.6% (t-1w) to -21.0% (t-0w), a 10.4 percentage-point drop in one week. This sharp workplace withdrawal signals a major disruption event (lockdown, closure, or policy tightening) that will suppress retail-and-recreation mobility over the next two weeks as people remain confined.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 8 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped 10.4 points in one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days rises above the mean of the last 14 days (-9.8%).

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has recovered from -30.9% (t-3w) to -10.1% (t-0w), a 20.8 percentage-point improvement. This strong parks recovery indicates outdoor activity substitution is normalizing. Concurrent with RETAIL_REC improvement, this signals a broader reopening regime where retail will continue to recover over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -15% and RETAIL_REC rises above -10%
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 20.8 points over four weeks
failure_condition: Both PARKS and RETAIL_REC decline over the next 28 days, or PARKS falls below -20% while RETAIL_REC remains below -8%.

Persistent transit collapse indicates ongoing mobility restrictions or public transport closure. This constraint will prevent retail recovery by limiting customer access to retail zones over the next four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stable at -31% to -35% across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds -5%, or TRANSIT rises above -25% within the first two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has remained stable and positive (1.7% to 2.7%) across all four weeks, indicating essential shopping is maintained. This substitution effect will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM positive and stable while WORKPLACES falls below -15%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days rises above -7%, or WORKPLACES recovers above -15%.

Retail will remain suppressed over the next week as this regime persists.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 5% and remains elevated
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days rises above -6%, or RESIDENTIAL falls below 4%.

RETAIL_REC will decline over the next week as the restriction regime tightens.
